title: Concept: Rails web-console rendered in a page
description: The web-console is an interactive Ruby prompt bound to the current request. Any expression evaluated there can read the database credentials, write files and reach the network, so its presence in a production response is equivalent to an unauthenticated shell.
applicability: Responses from a Rails application that renders the console outside development.
risk: The caller evaluates arbitrary Ruby in the application process and can read secrets or write to the database.
